theme_strategy.rationale: The user explicitly rejected three previous designs (Royal Blue/Gold, Green/Coral, Earthy) because they felt 'structurally the same' (standard big balance + card grid). To completely surprise and delight them, we are abandoning standard 'SaaS cards' entirely. We are using a 'Ledger / Prospectus' layout: full-bleed sections separated by stark borders, radical typography scaling (massive numbers, tiny mono labels), and aggressive contrast. This feels like an elite, high-end financial terminal rather than a generic template app.

color_palette.notes: Primary is 'Safety Orange' (#FF3B00) used EXTREMELY sparingly (only for the exact CTA or active timer). 95% of the UI must be monochrome.

typography.numbers_and_labels: JetBrains Mono (font-mono). Use for ALL balances, timers, and tiny overline labels.
typography.hierarchy_rules: Extreme contrast. Labels should be `text-[10px] tracking-[0.2em] uppercase`. Main balances should be `text-5xl md:text-7xl tracking-tighter`. Skip middle sizes.

layout_system.container: No side padding on the main wrapper! `px-0`. Elements span edge-to-edge. Use inner padding (`p-6` or `p-8`) inside sections.
layout_system.separators: Use `border-b border-foreground/20` (or solid foreground) to separate every vertical section. NO gaps, NO floating cards. Everything is a stacked block.
layout_system.border_radius: Strictly `rounded-none`. This is a brutalist ledger, not a soft app.

home_announcement.design: Instead of a static banner card, implement a continuous slow-scrolling marquee at the very top of the page. `bg-foreground text-background font-mono text-xs py-2 uppercase tracking-widest`. Use `react-fast-marquee`.

greeting.design: Full width block, `p-6 border-b border-border`. Top line: Today's date in JetBrains Mono `text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase`. Bottom line: First name in Cabinet Grotesk `text-3xl font-black uppercase`. No avatars.

wallet_balance.design: Full width block, massive padding `py-12 px-6 border-b border-border`. Label: 'TOTAL LEDGER BALANCE' (`font-mono text-[10px] tracking-[0.2em] mb-4 block`). Value: `font-mono text-6xl tracking-tighter`. Do not put this in a 'card'. It is the page background itself.

primary_actions.design: A grid of 2 columns right below the balance: `grid grid-cols-2 border-b border-border`. The Deposit and Withdraw buttons are NOT standard buttons. They are massive clickable zones. `p-6 text-center font-bold uppercase tracking-widest hover:bg-foreground hover:text-background transition-colors`. Right border on the first item to separate them.

daily_reward.design: A stark, high-contrast row. `flex items-center justify-between p-6 border-b border-border`. Left side: 'DAILY REWARD' label + Mono Countdown Timer. Right side: A sharp, square `rounded-none bg-primary text-primary-foreground px-6 py-3 font-mono text-sm` button. If on cooldown, make the button disabled and `bg-muted text-muted-foreground`.

featured_plan.design: Full-bleed image section. `relative h-[400px] w-full border-b border-border`. Background image uses the black & white architecture photo. Heavy `bg-black/60` overlay. Content sits at the bottom of the container (`absolute bottom-0 p-6 w-full text-white`). Title: Cabinet Grotesk 4xl. Stats (ROI, Duration) in a `grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 border-t border-white/20 pt-4 mt-4 font-mono`. Invest CTA is a sharp white button with black text.

quick_actions.design: Forget grids of icons. Use a strict textual index list. Each action (Referral, Packages, Coupons) is a full-width row: `flex justify-between items-center p-6 border-b border-border hover:bg-foreground hover:text-background transition-all group`. Left side: Numbered index (`01`, `02`) + Action Name. Right side: Arrow icon (`->`) that translates right on hover.

welcome_modal.design: Full screen `backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/90`. The modal content is a sharp rectangle `border-2 border-foreground bg-background p-8 rounded-none max-w-sm w-full mx-4 shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]` (in dark mode, white shadow). Massive 'WELCOME' headline.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Invert colors on hover for list items (background becomes foreground, text becomes background).
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Instant or very fast `duration-150`. Brutalism does not use slow, easing animations. It snaps.

featured_plan_bg.description: Minimalist high-end black and white architecture. Use as the background for the Featured Investment Plan to give an elite, structural feel.

welcome_modal_bg.description: Monochrome pattern texture. Can be used as a subtle noise overlay on the Welcome Modal or page background.

implementation_notes_for_main_agent: 1. Do NOT wrap the main content in standard 'container mx-auto px-4' padding. The layout relies on full-bleed edge-to-edge borders. 2. Implement the typography scale strictly. Do not use 'text-lg' when the spec calls for extreme sizes (text-[10px] vs text-5xl). 3. Replace all 'Cards' with raw HTML `div` blocks carrying `border-b` classes. 4. Ensure `.user-theme.light` and `.user-theme.dark` CSS custom properties are updated in index.css as defined.
